# webview

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Browser webview: the active tab's page streamed from the engine's Chromium — JPEG screencast frames drawn on a canvas, mouse / wheel / keyboard / IME / clipboard input sent back over the tab's engine socket, the page's dialogs, <select> menus, popups, downloads and file choosers (an upload prompt streaming the picked files to the page) rendered with app primitives, and a 'Show it here' state when another window took over the tab — with a loading bar, the start page for an empty tab, closed tabs' remote pages closed on the host, plus an open-in-system-browser chrome action.
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `Browser.Viewport` "Viewport" → `Viewport`
    - `Browser.Actions` "Chrome actions" → `OpenExternal`
  - Uses: 35 symbols — full list in [REFERENCE.md](./REFERENCE.md)
    - `primitives/css/ui-kit` ×9
    - `apps/browser/shell` ×6
    - `primitives/css/overlay` ×2
    - `primitives/css/spacing` ×2
    - `primitives/networking` ×2
    - `primitives/overlay/cursor-menu` ×2
    - `primitives/css/center.Center`
    - `primitives/css/clip.Clip`
    - `primitives/css/fill.Fill`
    - `primitives/css/placeholder.Placeholder`
    - `primitives/css/surface.Surface`
    - `primitives/css/text.Text`
    - `primitives/dom/element-size.useResizeObserver`
    - `primitives/latest-ref.useLatestRef`
    - `primitives/link-gesture/new-tab.NewTabButton`
    - `primitives/log-channels.clientLog`
    - `shell/toast.showToast`
    - `ui/icons.Icon`
- Cross-plugin:
